task_name: Interleave attached chapter media in the shared editorial renderer
user_visible_outcome: An editor can place attached photos and video between story passages, and private preview matches the eventual family chapter composition.
user_journeys: An editor places already-attached media between selected story blocks and safely reorders or removes only the placement.
An editor previews the unpublished chapter with interleaved photographs and video on desktop and mobile.
A family reader receives the same shared chapter composition after a later explicit publication decision.
non_negotiable_quality: Preserve existing story copy, captions, alt text, attachment order, cover choice, media assets, and unpublished state.
Keep photographs contained without cropping and keep video click-to-play with no autoplay.
Use the same renderer for private preview and the family chapter.
realistic_harms_prevented: Removing a body placement must never delete or detach its underlying private media asset.
Invalid or missing media references must not erase surrounding story content or captions.
This composition task must not publish the private draft.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The editor can place any attached photo or video as an existing validated media block and remove only the placement without deleting the asset or its caption.
Private preview loads draft video records and uses the same ChapterRenderer used by the family chapter.
acceptance_criteria.proof_command: Inspect preview and family renderer call sites

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Placed media renders between selected story blocks while only unplaced media appears in the safe fallback gallery.
Photographs remain contained, videos do not autoplay, and desktop and 375px compositions remain usable.
acceptance_criteria.proof_command: Authenticated desktop and 375px production preview inspection

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The production build is ready and authenticated preview evidence shows an interleaved chapter composition.
Existing story copy, captions, alt text, attachment order, cover choice, media assets, and publication state remain unchanged except for explicit body-block placement references.
acceptance_criteria.proof_command: Compare the Admin draft before and after placement-only save

non_goals: Editing story copy, captions, alt text, attachment order, cover choice, or media files
Changing database schema or storage services
Inferring placement from prose or photographs
simplest_acceptable_approach: Reuse the existing validated media body block and shared ChapterRenderer, add explicit editor placement controls, and load attached draft videos into private preview.
verification: Authenticated desktop and mobile private preview
